access_method: OGD datastore API with public sample key; responses clamped to 10 records/request, paginated with &offset= at 0.6s intervals with retry/backoff on 429/TLS stalls; filters[company_status]=Strike Off for negatives + unfiltered slices for the graph. No bulk file exists: catalog is Elasticsearch-backed (target_bucket index 'mca'); format=csv is clamped identically; dmspublic download endpoint is OPTIONS-only and the legacy v1 datastore API returns HTTP 500.
note: Real MCA struck-off CINs across 4 RoCs. Dataset has no PAN/DIN columns (pan left empty). 129,694 Strike Off rows exist in the Delhi resource alone; a registered (free) data.gov.in key removes the 10-row clamp for production. RESERVED persona ids filtered; CINs validated against ^[LU]d{5}[A-Z]{2}d{4}[A-Z]{3}d{6}$.
